about.heroSubtitle: With over 15 years of experience, we bring kimonos, robes and pestemals crafted from natural fibers to the world.
about.storyTitle:
From Denizli to the World:
The Story of Kimono & Pestemal
about.storyP1: Ripe Home was born in Denizli, Turkey's textile hub, with a deep passion for natural fibers. Since day one, our mission has been to unite traditional kimono and pestemal weaving with contemporary design and bring it to the world.
about.storyP2: Crafted by hand from 100% cotton, muslin, and other natural materials, our kimonos, robes, and pestemals stand out for their lightness, breathability, and distinctive patterns. Every piece passes through the skilled hands of Denizli's master weavers before reaching you.
about.storyP3: We provide reliable wholesale production and custom order services to business partners in more than 50 countries — including boutique hotels, spas, resorts, and lifestyle brands. Our ability to deliver competitive pricing without compromising quality is the foundation of our strong industry reputation.
about.missionText: To bring kimonos, robes, and pestemals crafted from natural and sustainable materials into everyday life — making it more comfortable, elegant, and authentic. To create long-term value for our business partners through reliable supply, competitive pricing, and impeccable service.
about.visionText: To become a globally recognized name in kimono, robe, and pestemal craftsmanship. Through sustainable production and innovative design, to be the world's most trusted source for natural, handcrafted Turkish textiles.
about.valuesTitle: Our Values and What Sets Us Apart

values.naturalRawDesc: We use 100% natural cotton, bamboo, and linen fibers in all our products. We never compromise on our commitment to nature-friendly production.
values.certifiedQualityDesc: Our Oeko-Tex Standard 100 certified products contain no chemicals harmful to human health.
values.reliableSupplyDesc: We are always a dependable supplier to our business partners with on-time delivery and consistent quality.
values.customerFocusedDesc: We offer tailored solutions to every customer, providing personalized service based on their needs.
values.ownProductionDesc: We carry out high-quality production with state-of-the-art machinery at our modern facilities in Denizli.
values.globalVisionDesc: We bring Denizli's kimonos and pestemals to the world, exporting to more than 50 countries.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

questions.q: What is the minimum order quantity for wholesale?
questions.a: Minimum order quantities for wholesale vary by product. Generally, wholesale pricing applies to orders of 20 units or more. For detailed information, please contact us through our Wholesale Orders page.

questions.q: What is the fabric composition of your products?
questions.a: Our products are made from 100% natural cotton and muslin fibers. No chemical additives are used; they have a skin-friendly, breathable, and natural structure.

questions.q: How much is the shipping fee?
questions.a: Shipping costs are entirely at the buyer's expense. For wholesale orders, shipping costs may vary depending on order volume and delivery address.

questions.q: When will my order be shipped?
questions.a: Your order will be prepared and shipped within 2–6 business days. Orders placed on weekends are processed the next business day.

questions.q: Can I get special pricing as a wholesale customer?
questions.a: Yes, we offer special pricing and payment terms to wholesale customers who place regular and high-volume orders. For detailed information, please speak with our sales team.
Yes, we offer international shipping for wholesale orders. Shipping costs and delivery times vary by destination country. Please contact us for detailed information.

questions.q: What are the care instructions for the products?
questions.a: Our products should be washed at 30°C on a delicate cycle. Do not use bleach or fabric softeners with harsh chemicals. Dry in the shade, away from direct sunlight. Can be ironed at low heat. See the 'Washing Instructions' button at the bottom of the page for full care details.
Yes, we issue e-invoices for all orders. We handle all necessary documentation for our corporate customers.

questions.q: Do you offer custom designs or logo printing?
questions.a: Yes, we offer custom design, color, and logo printing services for wholesale orders. Please contact our sales team for minimum order quantities.

faq.happyToHelp: Our customer service team is happy to assist you.

faqs.q: How can I track my order?
faqs.a: Once your order is shipped, a tracking number will be sent to you via SMS and email. You can track your shipment in real time on the courier company's website using this number.

faqs.q: Can I change my delivery address?
faqs.a: You can change your delivery address before your order is handed over to the courier. Simply contact our customer service team to make the change.

faqs.q: What should I do if I receive a damaged product?
faqs.a: If you receive a damaged package during delivery, accept it with a damage report and contact us within 24 hours. Your damaged product will be replaced free of charge.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order amount for wholesale?
faqs.a: The minimum order amount for wholesale varies by product category. For detailed information, you can visit our wholesale order page or contact us directly.

returns.label: Return Policy
returns.title: Returns & Exchange
returns.conditionsIntro: You may return your products within 14 days of the delivery date.
conditionItems: The product must be unused and unwashed
It must be in its original packaging with all tags attached
A copy of the invoice must be included
Due to hygiene regulations, disposable and personal items cannot be returned

processSteps.title: Return Request
processSteps.text: Submit your return request through our Contact page or at info@ripehome.com.tr. Please include your order number and reason for return.

processSteps.title: Approval & Shipping
processSteps.text: Once your return request is approved, you will receive a prepaid return shipping code. You can ship the product free of charge via our contracted courier.

processSteps.title: Inspection
processSteps.text: The returned product will be inspected and approved within 2-3 business days after it reaches us.

processSteps.title: Refund
processSteps.text: After the return is approved, your payment will be refunded to your credit card or bank account within 5-7 business days.

returns.exchangeP1: If you wish to change the color, size, or model of a purchased product, you need to initiate a return first and then place a new order.
returns.exchangeP2: In the case of defective or damaged product delivery, a replacement will be shipped at no charge with shipping costs covered by us.
returns.wholesaleReturnsIntro: Return conditions for wholesale orders may differ. For wholesale orders:
wholesaleReturnItems: Full refunds are issued for manufacturing defects or damage
Special terms apply for customer-initiated returns
Please contact our sales team for detailed information
